result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its entry names from the configured aspect names, so renaming a scope aspect no longer drops it or `git-history.zip`. It compiles, but I didn't run any tests or try a renamed config.

The change is in `exportZips()` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`. It now builds the five entries from the main, test, generated, build-and-deployment and other aspects, in that order. Each file name comes from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same method that writes the loose `aspect_*.txt` files, so the lookup and the writer can't disagree. I also added the `NamedSourceCodeAspect` import.

With the default config the entries are unchanged. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry is `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. The `git-history.zip` step comes after the zip step and is untouched. It now runs as long as a `git-history.txt` exists, because the zip step no longer fails first.
